verdict.rationale: vLLM is a local/self-hosted inference engine that runs models on the user's own GPU/CPU hardware with support for NVIDIA/AMD/x86/ARM/Apple Silicon and more, meaning prompts and data stay on-device rather than calling a remote API; it exposes an OpenAI-compatible API server that can be run entirely locally. Community evidence confirms actual local usage and hardware support. Missing for 10: no explicit vendor statement about privacy/data-never-leaves-device guarantee, and no independent audit of network calls confirming zero telemetry/exfiltration.
